name: STL-10
description: The STL-10 dataset is an image recognition benchmark designed for developing unsupervised feature learning and self-supervised learning algorithms. Inspired by CIFAR-10, images are higher resolution (96x96 pixels), comprising 5,000 labeled training images, 8,000 test images, and 100,000 unlabeled images from a broader distribution.
